nodes.label: AWS Lightsail Deployment (Nginx+PM2+Certbot)
nodes.rationale: Migrated off Render's free tier because it lacks persistent disk, causing SQLite data to reset on every restart; Lightsail's persistent SSD fixes this.

nodes.label: SQLite→PostgreSQL Migration Path
nodes.rationale: Queries written in standard SQL so swapping only src/db.js's driver suffices when scaling beyond a single SQLite file.
